wins.label: AI Semiconductor Growth
wins.evidence: AI revenue grew 65% year-over-year to $20 billion, driving the semiconductor revenue for this company to a record $37 billion for the year.

wins.label: Strong Backlog
wins.evidence: We have $73 billion of backlog in place secured of XPUs, switches, DSPs, lasers for AI data centers that we anticipate shipping over the next 18 months.

wins.label: Revenue Guidance Increase
wins.evidence: We expect consolidated revenue of approximately $19.1 billion for Q1, up 28% year-on-year.

wins.label: Dividend Increase
wins.evidence: We are announcing an increase in our quarterly common stock cash dividend in Q1 fiscal 2026 to $0.65 per share, an increase of 10% from the prior quarter.

wins.label: Infrastructure Software Growth
wins.evidence: Infrastructure software revenue was up 19% year-on-year and represented 39% of total revenue.

risks.label: Non-AI Semiconductor Stagnation
risks.evidence: Non-AI semiconductor revenue is expected to be flat from a year ago, down sequentially due to wireless seasonality.

risks.label: Supply Chain Constraints
risks.evidence: We have to address critical supply chain on silicon and packaging, which is an interesting challenge that we have been addressing constantly.

risks.label: Gross Margin Pressure
risks.evidence: AI revenue has a lower gross margin than the rest of our business, and we expect gross margin to start to deteriorate as AI revenue ramps.

risks.label: Customer Customization
risks.evidence: Some customers prefer to control their own destiny by continuing to drive their multiyear journey to create their own custom AI accelerators.

risks.label: Market Competition
risks.evidence: Competitors are also investing in custom silicon and photonic fabric technology, which could potentially disrupt the market.

risks.label: Supply Chain Constraints
